text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical AI solutions in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning.

For your PTE writing checker REST API, I can build an endpoint that accepts an essay payload and returns structured JSON with scoring based on the rules in the Pearson scoring PDF. I’ll focus on clean API design, reliable score calculation logic, and easy integration with your preferred backend stack.

In a past telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons, achieving AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter and 3.1x top-decile lift.

I’d be glad to help you turn the scoring methodology into a working API.
